ios.desc:
Thiro is a focus timer that helps you focus on everything you do. It helps you concentrate on tasks in your study and work by tracking the time you spend on each task.

STAY FOCUSED:
- Keep track of each of your focus sessions as a timer or manually add a period of focus time.
- Set daily/monthly/yearly goals for your tasks and keep moving forward.
- Set countdown notification for every focusing session.
- Manage tasks in groups to keep everything in order.
- Archive finished tasks to help you focus more on your work or study at the moment.
- View detailed statistics of your time distribution.

FOCUS EVERYWHERE:
- Seamlessly use Thiro on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac. Sync across all your devices using iCloud.
- Just start a focus session on one of your devices, and it will be seamlessly synced to all your devices.

MORE THOUGHTFUL FEATURES:
- Night-owl Mode: Records between 0:00 and 4:00 will be counted in the previous day's statistics. Statistics will not be interrupted even if you stay up late working or studying.
- Zen Mode: Accompany your work or study as a desktop clock.
- Notes: Jot down your ideas after finishing a session.
- Custom Appearance: Change theme and chart colors. 
- Turn over to Start: Turn the phone over to start a focus session.
- Widgets: View your statistics on the home screen.
- Siri & Shortcuts: Track your focus in a more automated way.

quotes.text:
A couple of small and simple iOS apps after being frustrated with more enterprise based solutions.

Thiro [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thiro/id1555982483] a basic time tracker that does grouping and reports right. The only thing it lacks is billable hours.

Emerald
[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/emerald-money-journal/id1437054263]
A super simple expense tracker that does most things right, but unfortunately has a few bugs. It’s the only one I could find available that is privacy friendly and doesn’t have bloat.

Both of those apps are made by indie devs and have no subscriptions.

In addition, I am trying out timeator[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/timemator-time-tracking/id1458451587]
which has the right idea for how I want revenue and time tracking to be integrated.
